Ethan (AE): Heads up — Bluestone POC ends Friday. They want a documented handback: revoke hosted keys, teardown the reserved pool, and confirm no retained customer content. Need owners and exact steps.

Rina (SE): Proposed window: Fri 22:00–23:30 UTC. Quick scope: hosted API keys + any SDK tokens, dedicated GPU pool 'bs-poc-pool', and VPC peer removal. Also ensure any temp service principals are removed.

Tomas (Eng-Infra): I'll own the pool lifecycle. Plan: drain -> export logs -> snapshot (if customer requests) -> delete volumes -> delete pool. Commands: 
```
# drain
ri pools set --name bs-poc-pool --mode drain
# export logs
ri logs export --pool bs-poc-pool --dest s3://redwood-exports/bs-poc/2026-02-01
# delete pool
ri pools destroy --name bs-poc-pool --force
```
Note: exports take ~20m for 200GB.

Asha (Security): We need an evidence CSV with: revoked_key_ids, deleted_pools, exported_snapshots, vpc_peer_ids, timestamp, operator. Store CSV in compliance bucket for 180 days unless legal requests longer.

Nora (Customer Sec): Bluestone requires proof that request/response payloads were not retained. They opted out of request storage but did enable telemetry. We'll need confirmation you deleted telemetry indices for their account.

Rina (SE): Telemetry purge command: 
```
ri compliance delete-telemetry --account bluestone-poc --confirm
```
This triggers async jobs; full effect ~48h. We'll post job id here.

Tomas (Eng-Infra): For hosted keys, I'll coordinate with Rina. Revoke pattern we use: 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"key":"bs-poc-host-01"}'
After revoke, run smoke checks for 5m.

Asha (Security): Also rotate org-level admin keys after teardown. And run a final scan for accidentally-committed creds in the project repo.

Ethan (AE): Owners: Rina -> hosted keys + telemetry purge. Tomas -> dedicated pool + logs export. Asha -> compliance evidence + rotation. Nora -> confirm customer's side steps. I'll communicate schedule.

Nora (Customer Sec): We need the list of service accounts and keys today so our IAM team can cross-check. Also please send the S3 export link and access method.

Rina (SE): Sharing DM with sensitive list. Public summary: bs-poc-host-01, svc-bs-poc-uploader, pool:bs-poc-pool.

ops-bot: Job queued: pools.drain(bs-poc-pool) -> run_at=2026-02-06T22:00:00Z job_id=op-5591

Tomas (Eng-Infra): Timeline: 22:00 drain start. 22:20 begin log export. 22:45 snapshot if requested. 23:10 delete volumes + pool. We'll wait for Asha/legal sign-off before permanent deletes.

Asha (Security): Legal asked to retain logs 30 days minimum. We'll keep exports for 30 days encrypted with customer KMS; if customer requests transfer, move to their bucket. If legal hold appears, stop and escalate.

Ethan (AE): Pricing question from customer: will they be billed for the final partial day of Dedicated? Finance suggested prorate; that's separate but won't stop teardown. I'll confirm credit flow after.

Nora (Customer Sec): Confirmed maintenance window OK. We'll watch for revoked-key failures on our side and report.

Rina (SE): After running 'delete-telemetry' I'll paste the async job id: job=ct-7742. Expect 48h.

Tomas (Eng-Infra): After pool destroy I'll post a deletion confirmation JSON blob (timestamped) and attach to the evidence CSV.

Asha (Security): Add to checklist: redact any snapshots that contain customer text — if redaction fails, transfer snapshot to customer's S3 and mark as 'customer-owned'.

Ethan (AE): Post-teardown checklist for thread closure:
- hosted keys revoked (Rina)
- telemetry purge job started (Rina)
- pool destroyed + logs exported (Tomas)
- evidence CSV uploaded (Asha)
- admin key rotation (Asha)
- customer confirms no further holds (Nora)

Nora (Customer Sec): We'll sign off once we see proof (CSV + export link + telemetry job id).

Rina (SE): I'll execute key revokes at 22:00 and paste results here.

ops-bot: Notification: pools.drain(bs-poc-pool) started (job_id=op-5591).

Tomas (Eng-Infra): Noted. I'll update with export URL when available.

Ethan (AE): Thanks team. Please post final ack in this thread once complete and I'll send closure email to Bluestone.
